answer: One defence is Proof of unique EV battery health report: a battery report tied to one VIN over years, and the zephyr of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because a battery report tied to one VIN over years, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the horizon for an established agent is already paid and proven. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ridge of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
